option.name: --base-time
tip: Calculate calendar times relative to this timestamp.

option.name: --detailed
tip: Add more details to the SVG plot.

option.name: --from-pattern
tip: Show only origins matching the glob in the graph.

option.name: --fuzz
tip: Also print services that finished this many seconds earlier.

option.name: --generators
tip: Do [not] run unit generators (requires privileges).

option.name: --global
tip: Operate on the global user configuration.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --host
tip: Operate on a remote host.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on a disk image as the filesystem root.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --instance
tip: Specify a fallback instance name for template units.

option.name: --iterations
tip: Show the specified number of iterations.

option.name: --json
tip: Generate JSON output of the security table or plot data.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --machine
tip: Operate on a local container.

option.name: --man
tip: Do [not] check for the existence of man pages.

option.name: --mask
tip: Parse the parameter as a numeric capability mask.

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Disable column headers and hints in the plot table.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --offline
tip: Perform an offline security review of unit files.

option.name: --order
tip: Show only order dependencies in the graph.

option.name: --profile
tip: Include the specified profile in the offline security review.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not emit hints.

option.name: --recursive-errors
tip: Control which units are verified.
Possible values: yes, no, one

option.name: --require
tip: Show only requirement dependencies in the graph.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate on an alternate filesystem root.

option.name: --scale-svg
tip: Stretch the x-axis of the plot by this factor.

option.name: --security-policy
tip: Use a custom JSON security policy instead of the built-in one.

option.name: --system
tip: Operate on the system systemd instance.

option.name: --table
tip: Output the plot's raw time data as a table.

option.name: --threshold
tip: Exit non-zero when the overall exposure level exceeds this value.

option.name: --tldr
tip: Skip comments and empty lines.

option.name: --to-pattern
tip: Show only destinations matching the glob in the graph.

option.name: --unit
tip: Evaluate conditions and asserts of the unit.

option.name: --user
tip: Operate on the user systemd instance.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.
